scope: User area relocation bug, width-only BRAKE, centered speed, right GO/FLY/CRUISE stack and mandatory landscape mobile play.

confirmed: Failure branches previously discarded the selected destination and reopened the generic chooser.
Whole-edge elevation filtering rejected clear ground segments when any remote vertex was elevated. Ground-only placement also excluded supported elevated-only destinations.
Saved-area bounds were indexed as an array, but shipped CoreData uses minX/maxX/minZ/maxZ.
Overlapping relocation calls were silently dropped by the relocating guard.
diagnosis.limit: Exact intermittent screenshot failure was not reproduced. Three actual source probes near the screenshot already found safe ground in the baseline; do not attribute that incident conclusively to elevation or network failure.
diagnosis.pinPrecision: The first probe is an approximate image-derived neighborhood coordinate, not the exact original pin.

behavior.relocation: Latest valid choice owns loading; obsolete completions/rejections are ignored. Aborted waiters release timers without cancelling shared tile work. Existing area, pending offer, coins and saved choice remain intact until successful safe placement.
behavior.failures: Retain exact destination in a Retry this destination / Choose nearby street / Stay here dialog. Nearby map starts at that destination; cancelling returns to the retry dialog. Invalid/off-map coordinates and accepted delivery changes are refused.
behavior.placement: Ground first, then verified elevated carriageway within 550 metres. Actual local road support, full vehicle footprint, one-way heading and eight-metre clear departure are required. No arbitrary fallback to old area or unloaded road.
behavior.layout: Speed centered at the bottom in desktop and touch UI. FLY and CRUISE share GO left/width and stack above it. Short-landscape map docks beside the thumb column when needed.
behavior.orientation: Touch portrait is blocked at title, menu and gameplay; no Play anyway bypass. Enter Full Screen Mode requests native fullscreen then landscape lock. Only real orientation changes remove the gate; denied/unsupported calls retain manual-rotate guidance.

offlineFailureCoverage: portrait denied/unsupported/successful API calls cannot bypass orientation
